summary: Incremental acceptance of 553d8941 against prior accepted 0eb0b4b. All three prior MINOR findings are closed: (1) check_kinds no longer breaks after the first matching category, so overlapping trusted masks require every matching suite; regression asserts ['backend','frontend'] for server/api.js under frontend '*.js' + backend 'server/*.js'. (2) run_checks detects touched classes without configured suites before any container run (test proves zero suite invocations) and emits a blocker naming the missing classes and the real recoveries (trusted-base configuration task or split), removing the impossible waive advice when another class is configured; missing-detection truthiness matches unit_has_checks, and the early-return shape is fail-closed (configured=False blocks full_green/verification regardless of the absent 'suites' key). (3) installer linked() lstats unconditionally on nt, ignoring only FileNotFoundError, so dangling junctions are detected and PermissionError/other OSErrors fail closed before any write; tests cover dangling, missing, and denied-inspection cases. No new BLOCKER/MAJOR: the early return skips guard_config only on a blocked, non-accepting path; trusted_config reads are deterministic on the immutable base; non-Windows installer behavior unchanged. One new MINOR guidance corner is reported: when all touched classes are unconfigured, the pre-check suppresses the previously shown (and still valid) waive exit. Unchanged executable code remains covered by the prior accepted SHA.

findings.problem: The new multi-class missing-suite pre-check in run_checks fires whenever len(kinds) > 1, including when ALL touched classes lack configured checks. In that case waiver_valid still permits a waiver (unit_has_checks is False), but the pre-check replaces the per-suite checks_env blockers that previously suggested waive, and its closing clause 'waive всей единицы при наличии настроенных проверок недопустим' reads as a prohibition even though no configured checks exist. The legitimate waiver exit is no longer surfaced.
findings.scenario: Fresh repo with no checks configured at all; a unit touches both a .py and a .tsx file. check_kinds returns ['backend','frontend']; missing = both; the blocker tells the lead to configure suites in a separate task or split the unit, and appears to forbid waiver. Previously the aggregated per-suite unconfigured blockers suggested waive, which works (waiver_valid is True since no class is configured). The lead may unnecessarily split a trivially waivable unit or open a configuration task. Behavior remains fail-closed and the waiver command still succeeds if attempted, so this is guidance-only.
findings.fix: Branch on whether any touched class has configured checks: if none do (unit_has_checks-equivalent is False), keep or restore the waive-suggestion wording (waiver with a >=20-char reason is valid); only emit the 'waive недопустим' clause when at least one touched class has a configured suite. Add a regression for the all-unconfigured multi-class case asserting the blocker mentions the waiver option.
